steps.title: Intradialytic hypotension
steps.body: Sudden drop in BP during HD from ultrafiltration, autonomic dysfunction, or cardiac disease. Presents with cramps, nausea, dizziness.
steps.tip: Treat with fluid bolus, reduce UF rate, and trend standing BP.

steps.title: Dialysis disequilibrium syndrome
steps.body: Headache, nausea, confusion, seizures near end of treatment — especially first sessions with very high BUN.
steps.tip: Brain osmolytes lag as urea is cleared → cerebral edema.

steps.title: Prevent DDS
steps.body: Slow initial sessions, limit urea clearance, consider daily short dialysis when starting. Mannitol or reducing blood flow in severe risk.
steps.tip: BUN >150–200 mg/dL at first dialysis increases risk.

steps.title: Hemolysis
steps.body: Cherry-red plasma, back pain, shortness of breath — check for kinked lines, overheated dialysate, chloramine exposure, or hypotonic dialysate.
steps.tip: Stop dialysis immediately and support hemodynamics.

steps.title: First-use and allergic reactions
steps.body: Chest tightness and bronchospasm with new dialyzer (bioincompatible membrane). Anaphylaxis to ethylene oxide sterilization also reported.
steps.tip: Use biocompatible membranes and premedication if recurrent.
